research.claim: Fixed-threshold Bernoulli Hoeffding bounds can propagate conditional bootstrap Monte Carlo error into a conservative gate
research.formula: epsilon=sqrt(log(2/delta)/(2B)); U=clip(K/B+epsilon); L=clip(K/B-epsilon); Promote if U<0.025, Block if L>0.975, otherwise Inconclusive
assumptions: iid bootstrap replicates conditional on fixed empirical data
PRNG implementation is a numerical demonstration, not proof of ideal iid sampling
research.claim_ceiling: Conditional resampling error only; no population coverage guarantee and no observed speedup
